description:
Goal
Make every fz2 diagnostic source-actionable by rendering the structured Diagnostic already carried through telemetry.

Signal
emit_through places the full Diagnostic (primary/secondary spans, labels, notes, helps) in opaque metadata. ConsoleDiagnosticsHandler in compiler2/cli.rs ignores it and prints only severity/code/message because it owns no SourceMap. The result is four indistinguishable one-line warnings and no file, line, snippet, label, note, or help. telemetry::diag_render::DiagRenderer and diag::render::Renderer already implement rich rendering.

Strategy
Put source ownership at the compiler/front-door boundary so the CLI diagnostic handler can resolve CodeId spans through the authoritative SourceMap. Reuse the existing renderer; delete the flattened ConsoleDiagnosticsHandler path rather than maintaining two rendering contracts. Preserve saw_error without parsing rendered text.

TDD
Pin exact stderr for one real user partial function through fz2 and verify dependency/runtime source names resolve correctly. Pin errors as well as warnings and NO_COLOR behavior.

Acceptance
- Diagnostics render location/snippet/labels/notes/help.
- The CLI does not flatten Diagnostic metadata.
- Span resolution remains valid for lazy runtime modules and macro-generated sources.
- Tests/docs/clippy pass.
title: Render telemetry Diagnostics with their source spans in fz2
